rationale.text: The test applies only to images that carry information, and whether an image conveys information needed to understand its content is judgment. The methodology gives a different list of accepted sources for each kind of element, so the entry splits the test by element type, as spec 6.2 allows: elements, with four sources (aria-labelledby, aria-label, alt, title), and other elements with role="img", with two (aria-labelledby, aria-label).
